name: @w6w-apps/littlegreenlight
description: Search, read and log constituents, gifts, notes, appeals, campaigns, funds and groups in Little Green Light, the nonprofit CRM.

w6w.longDescription:
Little Green Light (LGL) is a web-based CRM built for small and mid-size nonprofits to track constituents (donors, volunteers, members), gifts, notes, appeals, campaigns, funds and groups. This app covers LGL's documented REST API v1: searching and reading constituents, listing and logging gifts and notes against a constituent record, and reading appeals, campaigns, funds and groups.

Every path, parameter and model in this app was verified on 2026-09-05 against LGL's own machine-readable API reference — the Swagger 1.2 JSON served at `https://api.littlegreenlight.com/api-docs/json/api-docs.json` plus its 33 per-resource sub-documents — and against live probes of `api.littlegreenlight.com`.

Three things worth knowing before scripting against this API directly:

1. **Authentication is a plain Bearer token, not the HTTP Basic the server's own `WWW-Authenticate` header implies for a request with no `Authorization` header at all.** A garbage or expired token gets a second, more specific challenge instead — `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="Rack::OAuth2 Protected Resources"` with a structured `{"error":"invalid_token",...}` JSON body — which is the one this app's `test` hook actually classifies on.
2. **Search filters are an array of embedded `key=value` strings** (`q[]=name=brady`, repeatable for multiple constraints), not a single free-text query parameter — copying a plain search term into `q` silently returns nothing.
3. **Every list response shares one envelope** — `{ api_version, items_count, total_items, limit, offset, next_item, next_link, item_type, items: [...] }` — across every one of the 33 documented resources, so pagination is uniform even though there is no separate 'pagination' section in the reference.

See README.md for the full per-action detail, what was verified against the spec, and what was deliberately left out.
